We have deep expertise in Process Safety Management (PSM), Training, Implementation, Auditing, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA’s), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) and Facility Siting, among other engineering and consulting services. AcuTech has deep specialization in the oil and gas, chemical, LNG, petrochemical, renewables, hydrogen, and other industries handling hazardous materials. Our industry experts deliver these services to leading privately held and publicly traded companies, as well as government agencies, and state sponsored entities globally. This individual will be responsible for maintaining project and organizational documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The role is pivotal in ensuring document integrity, supporting efficient project workflows, and facilitating communication across multidisciplinary teams. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:7b.title: Quality Control Manager
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:7b.description: Come join our team at Millennium Galvanizing! Millennium Galvanizing is a proud member of the American Galvanizing Association. We operate with a lead free kettle using special High Grade Zinc that is supported by the most technologically advanced equipment in our industry. Millennium Galvanizing can also perform painting, metalizing and paint over bare blasted steel as well as paint over galvanized steel for sensitive areas of installation that require an aesthetically pleasing coating application. Purpose of the Role Lead the quality control team to ensure all galvanized products meet customer requirements and industry standards. Oversee inspections, guide QC technicians, resolve quality issues, and support a consistent, reliable galvanizing process. Key Responsibilities Quality Oversight - Ensure galvanized products meet ASTM and AGA standards for coating thickness, appearance, and adhesion. - Review and maintain quality procedures, inspection steps, and required documentation. - Approve final product quality and ensure repairs or touch-ups meet spec requirements. Team Leadership - Lead and develop QC Technicians, ensuring consistent inspection practices across all shifts. - Provide training on inspection techniques, visual standards, and use of measurement tools. Daily QC Operations - Oversee inspections at all stages: receiving, pre-treatment, kettle, and post-dip cleaning. - Monitor key process variables and address surface prep or coating concerns. -Complete Chemical Analysis, ensuring performance of pre-processing tanks. - Manage nonconformance reports and drive corrective actions. Audit & Customer Support - Support and host customer or third-party audits. - Communicate quality requirements with DIS-TRAN Steel and resolve cross-facility quality issues. Continuous Improvement - Track quality trends and defect types; implement improvements to reduce rework and touch-ups. - Collaborate with operations and maintenance to address quality issues tied to equipment or process conditions. Safety & Compliance - Ensure QC work follows site safety standards for chemicals, heat exposure, and material handling. Minimum Qualifications - 5+ years in QC/QA for galvanizing or industrial coatings, with leadership experience. - Understanding of ASTM galvanizing standards. - Ability to read drawings, follow specifications, and use inspection equipment. - Experience participating in quality audits. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in hot-dip galvanizing operations (kettle, pre-treatment, or post-dip). - Familiarity with ERP systems and documentation processes. Work Environment - Frequent walking in production areas; exposure to heat, steam, and chemical tanks. - Must safely navigate production environments and use appropriate PPE.

Our partner is looking for a Senior Director of Underwriting, Fraud Monitoring & Boarding based in the United States. This senior leadership role will own the operational backbone of merchant boarding, underwriting, fraud monitoring, and portfolio risk management for a rapidly scaling B2B payments platform. You will lead teams and modernize risk operations through automation, analytics, and practical AI-enabled decisioning. The role combines hands-on operational leadership with strategic influence across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Sales, and banking partners. You will help create faster, more consistent onboarding experiences while maintaining rigorous controls for higher-risk customers. A major focus will be turning payments, transaction, and accounts receivable data into actionable underwriting and monitoring signals. You will also help shape the operating model for future embedded lending capabilities. Success will be measured through stronger risk governance, improved decision speed, scalable processes, and disciplined portfolio performance. Lead and scale teams across merchant underwriting, boarding operations, risk analytics, fraud monitoring, and portfolio risk, establishing clear performance expectations, coaching, and development plans. Own day-to-day merchant boarding and underwriting operations across payments and future lending applications, ensuring efficient, consistent, and controlled execution. Redesign onboarding and underwriting workflows around intelligent automation and AI-assisted decisioning, enabling straight-through processing for low-risk applications while routing complex cases to appropriate human reviewers. Define and operationalize risk appetite, credit policies, exposure limits, approval authorities, escalation thresholds, and exception-management processes across merchant segments. Establish effective risk governance routines, including delegated authority workflows, exception reviews, quality controls, and recurring reporting for senior leadership and sponsor bank stakeholders. Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, and external vendors to modernize KYB/KYC, beneficial ownership, sanctions screening, fraud detection, bank-data connectivity, transaction monitoring, and decision orchestration capabilities. Implement automated document-review and decision-support capabilities while ensuring automated outputs remain explainable, auditable, reviewable, and subject to appropriate human oversight. Contribute to the design of future embedded lending operations, including application intake, underwriting policies, documentation requirements, exposure and line-assignment inputs, exception handling, servicing controls, and loss mitigation. Partner with Finance and senior leadership on portfolio performance, loss forecasting, vintage analysis, reserve modeling, pricing inputs, and the economics of future lending products. Own ongoing merchant risk monitoring, including transaction surveillance, chargebacks, returns, ACH trends, behavioral anomalies, fraud indicators, and early signs of credit deterioration. Develop executive and sponsor-bank dashboards covering merchant exposure, fraud, losses, exceptions, chargebacks, returns, and other critical risk indicators. Establish and lead response protocols for significant events such as fraud rings, processor issues, funding disputes, NSF activity, and breaches of merchant agreements. Maintain compliance with applicable NACHA, BSA/AML, OFAC, card-network, state lending, and sponsor-bank requirements across U.S. and Canadian operations. Serve as a key operational contact for sponsor banks and processors during audits, file reviews, exception requests, policy discussions, and regulatory or compliance activities. Translate risk strategy into measurable KPIs and SLAs, including time-to-decision, approval rates, fraud basis points, loss

jobgether-jobgether:lever:fe3fb0e7-a621-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer based in the United States. The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer will transform complex and high-volume data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. You will design and optimize BI solutions, including dashboards, reports, data models, and analytical applications. The role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. You will play a key role in maintaining data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and usability across business intelligence deliverables. Your analysis and visual storytelling will help communicate important trends and recommendations to senior and executive leadership. The position offers the opportunity to work with healthcare data in a large, complex organization while solving challenging analytical problems. This is a fully remote role suited to an independent, analytical professional who thrives in a collaborative and data-driven environment. Design, develop, maintain, and optimize business intelligence solutions, including dashboards, reports, data models, and applications. Transform complex datasets into meaningful business intelligence that supports strategic and operational decision-making. Conduct advanced data analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights. Develop clear and impactful data visualizations for technical stakeholders, business leaders, and executive audiences. Partner with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into effective technical and analytical solutions. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, consistency, and reliability across BI deliverables and reporting outputs. Investigate and resolve moderately complex to highly complex analytical and technical challenges using independent judgment. Optimize existing BI solutions to improve performance, usability, scalability, and overall business value. Work with large and complex datasets within a sophisticated organizational and healthcare data environment. Support strategic initiatives by delivering accurate analysis, reporting, and decision-support tools. Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams while communicating complex analytical findings in a clear and accessible manner. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics, or a related technical role. Advanced proficiency in SQL for data analysis, transformation, and querying. Expert-level experience developing visualizations, reports, and applications using Power BI and Power Apps. Advanced experience working with large, complex datasets in enterprise environments. Experience working with healthcare-related data and an understanding of relevant regulatory and data privacy considerations. Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical analysis into clear business insights. Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage complex assignments with limited supervision. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across technical and business functions. Bachelor’s degree is preferred. Experience with Python or other programming languages is preferred. Knowledge of DevOps practices within business intelligence environments is an advantage. Experience with cloud technologies such as ASA and/or Databricks is preferred. Previous delivery of analytics solutions within healthcare or related domains is a plus. Ability to work remotely from a dedicated, interruption-free environment that protects sensitive member and healthcare information. Reliable home internet service with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload speeds is required for remote work. Pre

southparkcommons-longshot:rippling:0f545.description: Who are we? Longshot Space Technologies is at the cutting edge of low-cost space access and hypersonics. We are developing a novel space launch system that accelerates mass over a long distance. Using our technology, we plan to provide affordable launch services for satellites, cargo, and future space infrastructure. Our mission is to enable a future where humans can reach for the stars. Position Overview We are looking for an IT Specialist to design, build, deploy, and maintain the systems that support an engineering, prototyping, and production aerospace startup. You will manage day-to-day technology operations for our engineering, technician, and operations teams while building the compliant, scalable infrastructure we need as we transition to full-scale engineering and manufacturing. This is an individual contributor role on a small team at the start of an ambitious 12 to 18 month growth plan. You will work across mixed operating systems, including some proprietary tools. You will both improve what exists today and help set the direction for the company's IT infrastructure going forward. You will be successful here if you have a high sense of ownership, an eagerness to learn, and a genuine appetite for interesting problems. Job Details Role Type: Full-time, Exempt Compensation: $100,000 - $130,000 annual salary Location: Onsite in Alameda, CA Key Responsibilities Design, secure, and harden our network, and manage it day to day Build and deploy IT systems that are reliable on day one and straightforward to scale Provide hands-on IT support and manage the help desk ticket queue Automate routine IT tasks with scripts in PowerShell and Python Identify, triage, and remediate issues using logs and other diagnostic data Implement CMMC and NIST 800-171 compliance initiatives Own our database and hardware infrastructure, including day-to-day operations and resiliency Administer and improve our SSO and identity systems Deploy and manage internal AI tools Handle user onboarding and offboarding Required Qualifications Associate's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience 3 to 5+ years in IT support, help desk, or desktop support Proficiency with Windows, Linux, and virtualization Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and peripheral equipment Advanced understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi Strong problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills Mission driven, collaborative, and focused on outcomes Eagerness to learn and grow Preferred Qualifications: Experience in a regulated environment such as aerospace, defense, or manufacturing Advanced knowledge of Windows (desktop and server) and Linux (server and workstation) Corporate networking experience with Cisco or similar, including firewalls, RADIUS, and advanced gateway, router, and switch configuration Experience deploying, managing, and automating cloud services such as Microsoft GCC High or Amazon Bedrock Scripting experience beyond PowerShell and Python, such as Go or Bash Experience building or maintaining high-security enclaves and air-gapped systems. Work on CUI or Secret-rated systems, including SCIFs, is a strong plus Hands-on experience standing up SSO or other identity and authentication systems Familiarity with AI tools in a production environment Experience at an early-stage startup Benefits Comprehensive health and dental insurance 401(k) with company match Paid time off and paid sick leave Equity opportunities Professional development opportunities 90-day integration period Equal Employment Opportunity Longshot Space Technologies Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Speeders Car Wash (Kearny) 946 Passaic Ave, Kearny, NJ 07032

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:12511ff5-508.title: English to Portuguese (Brazil) Patent Linguist
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:12511ff5-508.description: As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. Welocalize delivers multilingual content transformation services in translation, localization, and adaptation for over 250 languages with a growing network of over 400,000 in-country linguistic resources. Driving innovation in language services, Welocalize delivers high-quality training data transformation solutions for NLP-enabled machine learning by blending technology and human intelligence to collect, annotate, and evaluate all content types. Our team works across locations in North America, Europe, and Asia serving our global clients in the markets that matter to them. www.welocalize.com To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. OVERVIEW We are looking for translators with experience in translating patents from English into Portuguese (Brazil) (native-level fluency of Portuguese) with immediate availability for a patent translation project. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in translating and proofreading patents, specifically in the field of Chemistry, Computer Science, Electricity. Project Details: Job Title: English to Portuguese (Brazil) Patent Linguist Start Date: ASAP Location: Remote Task Type: Translation, Copy Edit, LQA review Content Type: Chemistry, Computer Science, Electricity Expected Weighted Volume Per Week: +5,000 words CAT Tool: JIRA, XTM Employment Type: Freelance
responsibilities: Translate patent-related content from English into Portuguese(Brazil) ,  with original meaning conveyed in a manner that is readable and understandable to target audience.
Perform linguistic quality assessments (LQA) of translated content from English (en-US) to Portuguese (pt-BR).
Identify and correct linguistic errors, ensuring consistency in terminology, style, and adherence to client-specific guidelines.
Provide detailed feedback to translators and create comprehensive quality reports.
Ensure adherence to client-specific style guides, glossaries, and project guidelines.
Utilize CAT tools (JIRA, XTM) to review and assess translations efficiently.
Manage weekly capacity to handle +5,000 words per locale and ensure timely task completion.
qualifications: BS/BA in linguistics, translation, biology, or related fields.
2+ years of work experience in translation, linguistic quality assessment, copywriting, or copy-editing, specifically in patents or technical content.
Deep understanding of biological terminology and ability to adapt complex scientific language for target audiences.
Exceptional command of English (en-US) and Portuguese (pt-PT).
Proven experience in reviewing or translating patents or technical documents.
Proficiency in using CAT tools like JIRA and XTM for project management and quality assessment.
